title: Player HUD Layout Customization
rules: Edit mode is entered from Settings > HUD / UI anpassen.
Elements drag inside fullscreen safe area on mobile and desktop.
Positions are stored as normalized safe-area offsets so aspect-ratio changes remain usable.
Mobile and desktop HUD profiles store independent layouts.
Critical controls are clamped to safe area and cannot be dragged completely off-screen.
Reset current profile and reset all profiles are available.
HUD layout is local presentation only and never affects crossplay gameplay values or server authority.
